Stats

Dog
Gordis is an Undead Dog which can be found in the Durinbold Mausoleum in Baldur's Gate's Lower City.
“
Fearless Gordis, who would chase any prey and helped bring in our greatest trophies.
 „
— Plaque adorning his sarcophagus


Overview

He and his two ghastly canine comrades  Zina and  Rocky, plus their minder,  Houndmaster Pol, attack the party if their sarcophagi are disturbed with a successful  DC 15 Strength Check.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Bite ()
Damage: 8~23
3d6 + 5⁠Necrotic
Bite a target.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Fly ()

Fly to a target position

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Terrifying Howl ()

Let out a blood-curdling howl that  Frightens all beasts and humanoids that hear it.

 WIS Save
 Have Nice Gift! ()

Give your Houndmaster the  Prey Essence you collected.

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Loyal Furry Friend ()

Mourn the Houndmaster's death and join him in the afterlife.

 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)

Notable loot

Though nothing can be found in his ectoplasmic pile when defeated, the party can loot his sarcophagus to find:

  • 42x Balls
  • Potion of Speed
